_doc: Fixed review cameras for VIEW=compare CAMERA=<preset> (tools/vfx-shot/compare_plan.py) and skill-preview --view <preset>. Intent units: caster at the origin facing +x (enemy at +x), y up, z = the caster's RIGHT (the compare side camera). One key each at fov 45 (the compare client's FOV, so no relaunch; `eye` is dollied to 70). Real players see a skill from any angle: judge it from all of them.

front.label: in front of the caster (just off the enemy line)

opposite.label: the caster's left side (opposite the compare camera)

eye.label: a nearby player's eye, front-right, 3.5 blocks

top.label: straight above the caster (pitch 89), caster-forward = image top, caster's right = image right: the only view where a horizontal cut's CW/CCW is unambiguous
